state.bottleneck: Korail publishes no floor plan (구내도/평면도) for 부산역. Verified by reverse-engineering korail.com's webpack chunk map to the live endpoint GET /com/userStation.do (stationSeq 10279506): the response carries a floor-assigned facility INVENTORY with no geometry, and the component has no plan-image field. So interior fixture placement cannot be grounded in an official plan.
state.constraint: Project rule forbids arbitrary placement. Everything must derive from measurement of an official source, from regulation, or from an equally citable ground truth.
state.what_already_works: The building SHELL is already official and measured: MainShell FBX from 부산디지털로케이션, 2F concourse walkable, wall-based partitions measured (785/404/225/106/45 sqm), ceiling heights, floor materials. What is missing is the INTERIOR PROGRAM — ticket counters, benches, signage, gates, kiosks, lighting fixtures.
candidate_routes_not_yet_investigated: Someone else has already modelled the Busan station interior: Sketchfab, 3D Warehouse, Unity/Unreal asset stores, BIM/IFC files, university or government 3D city projects, OpenStreetMap indoor mapping (S3DB / IndoorOSM / SIT tagging), Korean 공공데이터포털 3D datasets, 국토지리정보원 실내공간정보 (indoor spatial information) which is a real Korean government programme

Reconstruct from photographs or video: photogrammetry (COLMAP, Meshroom, OpenMVS, RealityCapture), neural methods (NeRF via nerfstudio/instant-ngp, 3D Gaussian Splatting, DUSt3R/MASt3R which need no camera poses), monocular depth (Depth Anything V2, Metric3D), single-image-to-3D room layout (RoomNet, HorizonNet, LayoutNet, Structured3D-trained models)

Street-level and indoor imagery sources: Kakao/Naver roadview indoor, Google Street View indoor (Business View), Mapillary, YouTube walkthrough videos of 부산역, 네이버 블로그/티스토리 posts with interior photos, news photography

Floor-plan-like ground truth that is not a plan: fire safety inspection records, 건축물대장 (building register) and its 평면도 attachment, 건축도면 공개 via 세움터, 공공건축물 도면 disclosure requests, academic papers on Busan station renovation

Derive program from the measured shell itself: the official model may already contain interior fixtures as separate submeshes or materials (counters, benches, gates) that were never examined — the material atlas has 372 materials and only floor materials were ever read
state.user_instruction: Do not ask the user back when a bottleneck appears. Reason deterministically with Jev and loop to find solution paths. Research aggressively.

first_route.instructions: Which route should be attempted FIRST to obtain non-arbitrary interior program data?

criteria.mine_the_existing_official_model: Examine the official source's own 372 materials and submeshes for interior fixtures that were never looked for — cheapest, already licensed, already measured, and if fixtures exist there the whole bottleneck dissolves
criteria.find_existing_third_party_model: Search for an existing third-party 3D model of the interior
criteria.photo_video_reconstruction: Reconstruct geometry from photographs or walkthrough video using photogrammetry or neural methods
criteria.pursue_official_drawings: Pursue building-register or 세움터 architectural drawings through disclosure channels

reconstruction_viability.instructions: If photo/video reconstruction is needed, what is the realistic role of that output given the project forbids arbitrary placement?

criteria.positional_evidence_not_geometry: Use it as POSITIONAL EVIDENCE — where a counter or bench actually sits relative to the measured shell — and place repo/licensed assets at those measured positions, rather than shipping the reconstructed mesh itself
criteria.ship_reconstructed_mesh: Reconstruct and ship the resulting mesh as the interior geometry
criteria.not_viable: Not viable under the no-arbitrary-placement rule

parallelism.instructions: How should these routes be pursued?

criteria.all_in_parallel_then_rank: Pursue every route in parallel and rank by what actually returns citable data, because each is independent and failure of one says nothing about the others
criteria.strictly_sequential: Try them one at a time in cost order
